steps: Inspected existing RoundLoop/configs to pick a distinct concept (multi-gate breach vs linear ring spawn)
Authored ReplicatedStorage.BreachConfig (config-driven: gates, perGate, health, speed per wave)
Authored ServerScriptService.BreachDefense server script driving the lifecycle
Disabled the pre-existing RoundLoop script so only BreachDefense drives the round

recipe.text: BreachDefense is a config-driven wave system where enemies breach from multiple gates ringed around a central core. main() waits for a player, then per wave: intermission -> open the wave's configured gates -> spawn perGate enemies at each -> wait until every enemy's Humanoid.Died fires (player-level combat, no auto-kill) -> print CLEARED. After the final wave it sets RoundState=victory and prints VICTORY. All lifecycle events print with the [System] tag for VERIFY. RoundLoop was disabled to avoid two systems fighting the arena.
